description: Schedule one calendar row on Nova. Reads the row Post Type (set via update_calendar_row) and media URL: YouTube short vs video; LinkedIn video vs feed; Instagram reel for video files.

calendar_id.description: Content calendar id, from list_content_calendars or create_content_calendar.

notification_message.description: Short user-facing sentence for this action if the follow-up reply fails. Plain text only; do not mention template syntax or variable names.

publisher_pid.description: Project id from list_projects or create_project. Required: an account-scoped publisher key has no project of its own, so a call without it is rejected.

row_id.description: Calendar row id, from get_content_calendar or create_calendar_row.

name: schedule_calendar_row
